description: This file defines the UriResolver class, which provides static methods to resolve relative URIs against base URIs, including removing dot segments and relativizing URIs, in accordance with RFC 3986.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for resolving and relativizing URIs as per RFC 3986.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a path, resolving '.' and '..' segments according to RFC 3986 section 5.2.4.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, returning the absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Generates a relative URI reference from a base URI to a target URI.
